content:
Alice Chen: FYI — proposing we standardize the infra-tool builder image pipeline. Problem: drift, unsigned images, missing SBOMs, and inconsistent pinning across repos.

Marco Rivera: +1. Do you mean a single base image that all infra repos use? How treat OS patches?

Alice Chen: yes, one canonical 'redwood/infra-builder:stable' built from pinned layers. Process: build -> generate SBOM (syft) -> sign (cosign) -> push digest-tag -> open PR to infra-manifests repo via image-updater. Keep small runtime overrides per repo.

Priya Singh: Important: for reproducibility we must pin both base image digest and apt packages. We also need SBOM stored externally (GCS/artifacts registry). Also vulnerability scan (trivy) in the pipeline.

Casey Park: what about CI cache & rate limits on GH Packages? Registry costs if we store many digests.

Alice Chen: thoughts: use ephemeral builder images for PRs, but promote to 'stable' via promotion pipeline. Retention policy: keep last N promoted images and SBOMs (N=30) + daily cleanup for ephemeral PR images.

Marco Rivera: Example Dockerfile? Can we add a small snippet.

Alice Chen: ```
FROM debian:12@sha256:abc123...  # pinned
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
  ca-certificates git curl unzip gnupg
COPY tool-versions /etc/infra-tool-versions
RUN /usr/local/bin/install-tools.sh /etc/infra-tool-versions
```

Priya Singh: CI step example (GitHub Actions): ```
- name: Build and SBOM
  run: |
    docker build -t ${REGISTRY}/infra-builder:${GIT_SHA} .
    syft ${REGISTRY}/infra-builder:${GIT_SHA} -o spdx-json > sbom-${GIT_SHA}.json
    docker push ${REGISTRY}/infra-builder:${GIT_SHA}
    DIGEST=$(docker inspect --format='{{index .RepoDigests 0}}' ${REGISTRY}/infra-builder:${GIT_SHA})
    cosign sign --key $COSIGN_KEY ${REGISTRY}/infra-builder@${DIGEST}
    gsutil cp sbom-${GIT_SHA}.json gs://redwood-sbom/infra-builder/
```

Casey Park: who triggers image-promote? manual or autodeploy?

Alice Chen: Promote is automated: when image passes security gates (trivy + SBOM review) and CI smoke tests, pipeline creates a release tag and opens a PR in infra-manifests (GitOps) updating kustomize/argocd image tags. Argo/Flux then picks it up.

Build-Bot: [bot] Vulnerability check: trivy found low/medium issues on sha256:abc123 -> comment on PR

Marco Rivera: We should require digest pinning in manifests (image: registry/infra-builder@sha256:...) not mutable tags.

Priya Singh: Also add provenance: store build metadata (GIT_SHA, BUILDER_IMAGE_SHA, BUILD_TIME) alongside SBOM. Save as JSON in artifact store.

Alice Chen: open questions: storage cost for SBOMs vs retention; signing key management (use KMS/HSM); who owns the canonical base-image updates?

Casey Park: propose: platform team owns base-image and release cadence (monthly). Security team owns vulnerability gates. Infra-app teams consume promoted stable images and must pin digest.

Priya Singh: +1. Also add a 'rebuild-from-source' job so we can reproduce image from same inputs (git commit + base digest + tool versions).

Alice Chen: I'll draft the pipeline in infra/cicd and open RFC. Will include sample Dockerfile, GH Actions + Tekton variants, SBOM + sign + store, image promotion flow to infra-manifests (argocd). @Marco @Priya please review.

Marco Rivera: Will do. Can we add a map of artifacts: SBOM path, provenance JSON, signed digest, vulnerability report?

Alice Chen: yes, I'll attach schema in RFC.

Casey Park: :thumbsup:
